title: Split preparation run
statement: For every natural number $k$ and Boolean words $w,s$, running the split-preparation machine on input $w$, from its initial configuration with state $(0,	ext{false})$ and with $s$ on the first work tape and all other work tapes empty, for $2(|s|+1)$ steps yields the configuration with state $(2, |w|<|s|)$, input head at position $\min(|s|,|w|)+1$, first work tape storing $s$, every other work tape containing true exactly in cells $0,\ldots,|s|$, all work-tape heads at $0$, and empty output.
